scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run contract:test && npm test --workspace=server && node --test scripts/check-rust-toolchain.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run contract:build && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.verify: npm run toolchain:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.contract:build: node scripts/run-contract.mjs cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
